scope: Descriptive localization of behavior on the existing evaluation set. Thresholds chosen before inspecting phase data. No model or input changes beyond the previously tested code-swap variants. Native condition comparisons do not hold trajectories fixed.
checks: Require exact equality of all original per-episode records for all variants.
censoring: All step exposures and censored return attempts retained. Complete-trip phase durations are conditional on successful returns; selection limits causal interpretation.
first_return_20s: Exploratory addition after first two phase seeds; eligibility first_goal_step<1050, exact300-decision followup, capped20s return time; before/afterfirstnear components; four-comparison Holm family.
snapshot_supplement: Seeds1 and2 rerun as native-only branches to save before-input states; exact baselineepisode records required; fullphasefiles preserved.
turn_rate_scope: The optional turn-rate mean excludes pickup and episode-reset steps, where env.step resets angular velocity to zero.
